passage.title: Reading Part 3 - Test 08
passage.text:
Biodiversity Loss and Ecosystem Services

Biodiversity—the variety of life on Earth—is declining at an alarming rate, with species extinction accelerating to levels not seen since the dinosaurs disappeared. This loss threatens not only individual species but entire ecosystems and the critical services they provide to humanity. From clean air and water to pollination and climate regulation, these ecosystem services form the foundation of human civilization and economic activity.
